linda_cs: FYI customer (ACME) reports a streaming session that closed mid-response. Client then tried a resume ~30m later and got HTTP/1.1 403. They attached a pcap and SDK logs: https://acme-repro/pcap/stream-xyz.pcap :eyes:
ajay_eng: can you paste the request_id / stream_id and the exact path they hit? also need the resume token header if present. any client-side reconnect loop?
linda_cs: req_id=rs-8f9a, stream_id=stream-123, path=/v1/streams/resume, sdk=js@1.2.3. They say kv-cache rotation happened on their side ~30m before resume (they rotate keys frequently). pcap link above has the whole capture. billing team flagged duplicate resume events but no charge anomalies.
kyle_runtime: quick thought — if we rotate HMAC keys for resume tokens and our verify path doesn't consult the old key for a grace period, resume could 403. can we pull edge logs for rs-8f9a?
marina_obs: pulling metrics for us-east-1 now — I see a small spike in 403s from edge around 09:47 UTC. snippet: ```promql
sum(rate(http_responses_total{code="403",route="/v1/streams/resume"}[5m])) by (instance)
``` results show 3 hosts with +4x baseline at 09:47.
deploy-bot: deployment d/edge-auth-fix completed (version edge-auth@2026-03-16-03) :white_check_mark:
ajay_eng: linda, can you confirm whether the resume request contained "x-resume-token" header and whether the token string changed between initial open and resume? also paste the raw response body from the 403 if possible.
linda_cs: copied from pcap (excerpt):
```
Client -> Edge: GET /v1/streams/resume?stream_id=stream-123 HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.example
Authorization: Bearer **REDACTED**
x-resume-token: rtk.v1.eyJhbGciOiJI...

Edge -> Client: HTTP/1.1 200 OK
<stream chunks...>

Client -> Edge: GET /v1/streams/resume?stream_id=stream-123 HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.example
Authorization: Bearer **REDACTED**
x-resume-token: rtk.v1.eyJhbGciOiJI...(different suffix)

Edge -> Client: HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{
  "error": "invalid_resume_token",
  "request_id": "rs-8f9a"
}
```
kyle_runtime: that matches the HMAC-rotation hypothesis. two quick repro paths: 1) simulate old token + rotate verifier keys and attempt resume; 2) run a replay of the pcap against a staging edge with key rotation enabled. I can run (1) locally if someone gives me the verifier config and a sample token.
marina_obs: I grabbed the trace id from our tracing system for rs-8f9a: trace=trace-0a7b, link: https://traces.redwood/trace-0a7b — there's a short path that fails at auth/verify_resume with a 403 return. logs show: ```[auth] verify_resume: token=hmac-mismatch, key_id=20260316-rotate, tried_keys=[20260316-rotate]```
ajay_eng: two action items: (A) ask customer for full pcap + SDK debug log (they've already uploaded pcap, ask for full debug log) (B) eng-runtime to add a short grace period to the verifier that accepts the previous key id for ~2 mins after rotation. that should avoid midstream 403s during key roll.
linda_cs: customer is ok to temporarily re-open stream instead of resume; they've sent SDK debug log at https://acme-repro/logs/stream-xyz.log. asking for ETA on a fix — they want to avoid manual work.
kyle_runtime: I'll take this. repro plan: run local verifier, rotate key, attempt resume with pre-rotation token; if fails, implement fallback to check previous key id for a 120s window. estimate: repro + unit tests + PR in ~48h. assigning to eng-runtime queue.
marina_obs: created dashboard alert to detect spikes in resume 403s and a paged alert if rate > 5/min across region for 5m. added annotation for rs-8f9a window.
linda_cs: thanks — I'm sending customer a workaround (re-open stream) and that we'll deploy a fix in ~48h. I'll update ticket and close loop when PR merges. :thumbsup:
ajay_eng: if you need a hotfix earlier, we can ship a config flip on edge verifiers to enable previous-key acceptance for affected deployments.
kyle_runtime: noted. I'll open PR and include short changelog + canary plan. will ping here when testable build is ready. :eyes:
